title: Robinhood Wins Dubai License to Bring Bitcoin and Stock Trading to the Middle East in 2027
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Robinhood Wins Dubai License to Bring Bitcoin and Stock Trading to the Middle East in 2027 Robinhood has won DFSA approval to offer bitcoin, crypto and stock trading with custody from a new Dubai headquarters, with launch set for 2027. This post Robinhood Wins Dubai License to Bring Bitcoin and Stock Trading to the Middle East in 2027 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
